original_working_title: Nova & Pip — The Secret Below the Waterfall

characters.look: original cool blue voxel outfit, no Maizen likeness
original ochre-green voxel outfit, no Maizen likeness

beats.title: Cold open: pale amber pulse behind a waterfall
beats.action: Nova sees a brief amber signal; Pip wants to charge toward the water
beats.dialogue: Nova: That light blinked twice. Pip: Then something is calling us.
beats.audio: distant rushing water; low mystery sting
beats.continuity: a wet sketch is glimpsed but not collected

beats.title: An old sketch catches Pip's eye
beats.action: Pip retrieves a wet sketch marked with three dots; Nova warns that symbols may be a trap
beats.dialogue: Pip: Three dots on a map. Nova: Or three warnings.
beats.audio: paper scrape, water splash, cautious footsteps
beats.continuity: wet sketch held by Pip

beats.title: Choice: loud shortcut or quiet ridge
beats.action: A collapsed short bridge tempts Pip; Nova points to stone along the bank
beats.dialogue: Pip: Shortcut! Nova: Only if the bridge remembers how to stand.
beats.audio: loose wood crack; water growing louder
beats.continuity: choose ridge; bridge must not magically repair

beats.title: Pip tests the brittle bridge
beats.action: Pip steps on rotten planks; one gives way; Nova pulls Pip back without teleport
beats.dialogue: Pip: It looked solid! Nova: It sounded hollow.
beats.audio: wood snap, shoe skid, gasp
beats.continuity: Pip on same river side; map remains with Pip

beats.title: Nova designs a stone stepping route
beats.action: Nova and Pip place original grey blocks to reach a safe ledge; materials must decrement in hand inventory
beats.dialogue: Nova: One stone at a time. Pip: Slow can be smart.
beats.audio: block place Foley, shallow splashes, footfalls
beats.continuity: stable route accessible; three blocks spent

beats.title: The sketch points through falling water
beats.action: Three-dot symbol on bank aligns to a gap behind waterfall only at one camera position
beats.dialogue: Pip: The dots line up! Nova: Don't move—look behind the mist.
beats.audio: water roar, bright clue accent
beats.continuity: map still in Pip's left hand

beats.title: Quiet entrance and falling gravel
beats.action: Camera crosses waterfall plane without teleport; cave entrance visible, gravel falls deeper inside
beats.dialogue: Nova: No torches outside. Pip: Somebody else is in here?
beats.audio: close water rush then damp echo, distant falling gravel
beats.continuity: both characters wet; inventory persistent

beats.title: Pressure plate forces a decision
beats.action: Two cave lanes: shiny doorway with pressure plate versus dark ledge with symbols; Pip chooses to inspect before stepping
beats.dialogue: Pip: The bright door looks safer. Nova: Look at the floor first.
beats.audio: stone tap, held-breath pause
beats.continuity: avoid untriggered plate; neither character crosses plate

beats.title: Coded latch reveals a workshop
beats.action: Three carved marks match sketch; tapping stones in sequence opens a hidden workshop door
beats.dialogue: Nova: First, second, third. Pip: The map was a key.
beats.audio: three stone clicks, low latch mechanism
beats.continuity: door now unlocked, original mechanism not external mod claimed

beats.title: They build an invisible entrance
beats.action: Construct hinged-looking block doorway using explicitly authored pivot mechanism; don't pretend impossible game physics
beats.dialogue: Pip: It looks like plain rock! Nova: That is the point.
beats.audio: stone placement, switch click, quiet rhythm
beats.continuity: entry remains openable from both sides

beats.title: Power flows through a blue crystal
beats.action: A blue crystal powers door indicator; wires routed clearly to switch and warning bell
beats.dialogue: Nova: Power first. Pip: Then a door that listens.
beats.audio: hum rises, bell test, switch clicks
beats.continuity: crystal socket attached, no free-floating cable

beats.title: Emergency tunnel appears
beats.action: They dig a narrow fallback exit to river above flood line; mark location with unique chalk symbol
beats.dialogue: Pip: Another exit? Nova: One entrance is one mistake.
beats.audio: pick impacts, quiet scrape, breath
beats.continuity: safe route usable later; map placed on tabletop before test

beats.title: A hidden valve snaps open
beats.action: Pip nudges unlabeled valve; cave flood starts at floor level rather than instantly filling entire room
beats.dialogue: Pip: I only touched it! Nova: Shut the valve!
beats.audio: metal snap, water trickle escalating, urgency rise
beats.continuity: map knocked off table into flowing water

beats.title: They retreat without the map
beats.action: Characters backtrack through established escape route while water visibly climbs stairs, leaving map behind
beats.dialogue: Nova: The exit we built—now! Pip: But the map!
beats.audio: wet footsteps, deep thumps, urgent dialogue
beats.continuity: map lost in workshop; characters exit safely

beats.title: Water stops at a sealed hatch
beats.action: Nova seals a real hatch and redirects water to relief channel; flood rate decreases, but sketch remains lost
beats.dialogue: Nova: It can hold. Pip: We cannot leave the map.
beats.audio: latch slam, pressure groan, water fading
beats.continuity: sealed hatch intact, map not miraculously recovered

beats.title: A second route is behind the valve
beats.action: The sketch's three symbols appear on relief channel stone; Pip follows them back toward a catch net
beats.dialogue: Pip: Those marks are here too. Nova: Then the sketch isn't far.
beats.audio: drips, cave draft, tentative score
beats.continuity: flood contained, valve still needs reset

beats.title: The sketch is caught beneath the grate
beats.action: Pip uses an original hook tool to retrieve the wet sketch from a stationary grate; nothing teleports into inventory
beats.dialogue: Pip: Got you! Nova: Keep it above the water.
beats.audio: metal scrape, wet paper, relief
beats.continuity: map now with Pip; hook returned to belt

beats.title: They learn what the symbol warned
beats.action: The dots indicate valve-lock order, not treasure; Nova resets blue-amber-blue sequence to safely drain cave
beats.dialogue: Nova: It wasn't a treasure mark. Pip: It was the safety code.
beats.audio: sequential lever clicks and water settling
beats.continuity: warning bell off; workshop habitable again

beats.title: The hidden base is secured
beats.action: Both test latch and exit in real time, remove temporary debris, verify the crystal power and map shelf
beats.dialogue: Pip: We made it work. Nova: This time we test it twice.
beats.audio: calm footsteps, bell soft ding
beats.continuity: map placed safely on shelf, valve closed

beats.title: A second pulse under the floor
beats.action: Different amber flash travels from floor seams to unopened lower tunnel, raising a new mystery
beats.dialogue: Nova: That light came from below. Pip: So there is another room?
beats.audio: deep two-note pulse, sudden silence
beats.continuity: lower tunnel unopened; no new character introduced

beats.title: Resolve and next-episode question
beats.action: Characters stand outside at sunset and agree to return with supplies; question mark icon only in original branding
beats.dialogue: Pip: Tomorrow we open it? Nova: With a better plan.
beats.audio: waterfall ambience, warm resolution sting
beats.continuity: all prop states remain consistent; no Maizen logos or skins

asset_requirements.constraint: unique original shape/silhouette and clothing; stable material ID across views
unique original shape/silhouette and clothing; stable material ID across views
continuous river bank, one visible stone crossing, physically consistent waterfall
connected cave fork, hidden door, dry shelf, hatch and escape tunnel spatially stable
unique three-dot symbols; explicit hold/dropped/recovered state
valve state tracked CLOSED->OPEN->CLOSED with water level response
blue emissive material; illumination in cave physically coherent
flood grows and retreats by continuity; no teleporting water
show actual linkage in chosen backend and repeated opening/closing test
licensed original source, continuous ambience and location mixing
two distinguishable licensed original English voices; no cloned Maizen voices
